subject.title: fix(discord): retry reply session init conflicts to prevent silent message loss

question: Should shared reply-session code own permanent conflict recovery while Discord retains this bounded retry only as defense in depth?
rationale: Both this PR and https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101920 address the same conflict at different layers; code correctness alone cannot determine the intended permanent recovery boundary or combined retry budget.

options.title: Shared recovery plus narrow Discord retry
options.body: Use shared session self-healing as canonical and keep this bounded, replay-safe Discord retry only after combined-layer coverage proves the layers do not amplify retries or duplicate state.

options.title: Discord-only mitigation
options.body: Land the channel-level mitigation and defer shared self-healing, accepting that other channels may continue to need separate conflict policy.

options.title: Pause for shared recovery
options.body: Hold this PR until the shared-session proposal proves it fully resolves Discord delivery and makes the channel retry unnecessary.

recommendation.title: Shared recovery plus narrow Discord retry
recommendation.body: Use shared session self-healing as canonical and keep this bounded, replay-safe Discord retry only after combined-layer coverage proves the layers do not amplify retries or duplicate state.

likelyOwner.reason: This person is assigned and has the strongest recent history across both the Discord handler and shared session lifecycle surfaces.
